title: 阪神JFの後に・不屈たる様

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove fails to win the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies. Her ambition undeterred, she vows to use this loss as fuel for her next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days have passed since the race. The world at large is abuzz with debate, wondering which race Air Groove will run in next.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove wishes to become a shining beacon that all Umamusume aspire toward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In order to achieve that, she firmly announces that she will be running in the Tiara tour: the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.
